name: radar
description: Memory at the moment it matters: when a tool call touches what one of your memory files is about, radar attaches that memory's description and rules for the model to read. A lavender pixel-art radar pings each match.

memoryDirs.title: Memory folders
memoryDirs.description: Folders of memory files to index, separated by commas; ~ is your home. Empty means the auto-memory folder: autoMemoryDirectory from settings if set, else ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory.

toast.title: Toast on each ping
toast.description: Show RADAR ▸ <memory name> each time a memory is attached to a call.
